sql: select count(*) from content_drafts where brief like '[daily 2026-10-23 #%' and status <> 'rejected' and created_by = 'agent:mkt02' and content_type = 'post' and status = 'pending' and (guardrail->>'ok')::boolean and is_ai and prompt_version is not null and prompt_sha256 is not null and text like '%Nội dung có sử dụng AI%'
select count(*) from content_drafts where brief like '[daily 2026-10-23 #%' and status <> 'rejected'
select count(distinct left(brief, 21)) from content_drafts where brief like '[daily 2026-10-23 #%' and status <> 'rejected'
